description: Resolve PBDB reference_no values — the source publication on every paleobiology_search_occurrences and paleobiology_search_collections row — to full citations with authors, year, title, publication, volume, pages, and DOI. Pass the ids from a page of rows in one call: the first 25 distinct ids are resolved and any beyond that come back in remaining_reference_nos for a follow-up call. Ids PBDB has no reference for are listed in not_found. Results keep the order the ids were given.

reference_nos.description: PBDB reference ids to resolve, from the reference_no field of paleobiology_search_occurrences or paleobiology_search_collections rows. Repeats are resolved once. Up to 500 accepted; the first 25 distinct ids are resolved per call.

items.description: A reference_no from an occurrence or collection row.

name: paleobiology_get_references

attribution.description: CC-BY data attribution for the Paleobiology Database.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

not_found.description: Requested ids PBDB has no reference for. Empty when every id resolved.

items.description: A reference_no PBDB has no reference for.

notice.description: Guidance when some ids had no PBDB reference, or when more ids remain than one call resolves.

references.description: The references PBDB has, in the order their ids were given.

authors.description: Authors in citation order. PBDB stores at most 255 characters of additional authors, so a long list can end early or mid-name.

items.description: A person named on the reference.

first_name.description: Given name or initials, when recorded.

citation.description: Full citation as PBDB formats it, plain text, relayed as entered (authors, year, title, publication, volume, pages).

items.description: A person named on the reference.

first_name.description: Given name or initials, when recorded.

first_page.description: First page as recorded — not always numeric (e.g. "viii").

publication.description: Journal, book, or series the work appeared in (or the school, for a thesis).

publication_type.description: Kind of publication, e.g. "journal article", "book chapter", "Ph.D. thesis".

title.description: Title of the work. A book may carry its title in publication instead.

year.description: Publication year as PBDB records it.

remaining_reference_nos.description: Distinct ids past the first 25, not resolved by this call — pass them as reference_nos to resolve the rest. Present only when the input held more than 25 distinct ids.

title: paleobiology-mcp-server: get bibliographic references
